formulas.K1_0: sigma*sqrt(pi*L) (undrained elastic limit, nu_u; K of a Griffith crack is independent of elastic constants) -> 1 in units sqrt(pi*L) per unit |sigma_n|
formulas.K1_inf: sigma*sqrt(pi*L) (drained elastic limit, nu) -> 1 in units sqrt(pi*L)
formulas.p_faces_0: 2*(nu_u-nu)/(alpha*(1-2*nu)) * sigma  (= 2B/3, B=3(nu_u-nu)/(alpha(1-2nu)), since sigma_kk = -2*sigma on the faces)
formulas.K2_0: 0 (no mechanical load at t=0+; diffusive boundary layer of vanishing thickness)
formulas.K2_inf: 0 (steady state: p_ss=(2/pi)Re[arcsin(L/z)] harmonic and sigma_ij = 0 identically is the exact solution)
